app.name: FaceScan
app.tagline: Find your own photos from an event.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.linkSent: If this address can sign in, a link is on its way. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
signIn.devHint: Development: the link is printed in the API terminal.
signIn.orPasskey: Or sign in with a passkey
signIn.linkInvalid: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

passkey.offerText: Add a passkey on this device. No password needed.
passkey.staffRequired: Organisers and photographers must use a passkey.

landing.invalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask the organiser for a new one.
landing.intro: You are invited to find your photos from
landing.signInToContinue: Sign in with your email to continue.
landing.notReady: Photos are still being prepared. Please check back later.

consent.outdated: The notice was updated. Please read it again.

selfie.title: Take a selfie
selfie.disabled: Face search is not available yet.
selfie.instructions: Follow the prompts on screen: look straight, blink, turn slightly left, turn slightly right. Frames stay in memory only.
selfie.guidanceLighting: Use good lighting (avoid dark or back-lit rooms).
selfie.guidanceFace: Ensure your face is in the frame and remove sunglasses or face mask.
selfie.frontOnlyOption: Cannot turn head? Use front-only scan
selfie.cameraError: The camera could not be opened. Allow camera access and try again.
selfie.tooMany: Too many searches. Please try again later.
selfie.errSpoof: Live face not detected. Printed photos or screens are not allowed. Please present your real face directly to the camera.
selfie.errBlurry: The scan was blurry. Please hold steady and try again.
selfie.errDark: Too dark. Please move to a brighter, well-lit area.
selfie.errBright: Too bright or overexposed. Please adjust your lighting.
selfie.errBlink: Blink was not detected. Please make sure to blink clearly.
selfie.errTurn: Head turns were not completed. Please follow prompts or use front-only scan.
selfie.errFaceCount: Please make sure only one face is visible without sunglasses or mask.
selfie.borderlineFirst: Possible match found, but not clear enough to safely release photos. Please try a second scan from a slightly different angle or lighting.
selfie.borderlineSecond: We still couldn't confirm your match with enough certainty to release photos. You can search by scene description and claim your photos.

gallery.title: Your photos
gallery.notMeConfirm: Are you sure this is not you? This photo will be removed immediately and will never be released to you again.
gallery.notMeDone: Photo removed and excluded from future matches.
gallery.missing: Some photos missing? We only show photos we are sure about.
gallery.rejectionNotice: A photo claim was reviewed by the organiser and not approved.

privacy.title: Privacy settings
privacy.none: You have not consented to face search for any event.
privacy.confirm: Withdraw? Your matches for this event are deleted and you are signed out of it.
privacy.done: Consent withdrawn. Your matches were deleted.

organiser.title: Your events
organiser.name: Event name
organiser.inviteOnce: Copy this link now; it is shown only once:
organiser.added: Added. They can sign in with their email and must add a passkey.

upload.title: Upload photos
upload.done: Uploaded. The organiser will review them.

claims.title: Review claims
claims.approved: Claim approved. Photo released to guest's gallery.

welcome.eyebrow: Event photos, found by your face
welcome.lead: Sign in, look at your camera and blink. FaceScan finds the photos you are in from every event and shows them in your own private gallery.
welcome.fine: Your selfie is checked live and never stored. Only you can see the photos that match you.
welcome.signInFailed: Google sign-in did not work. Please try again.
welcome.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in could not load. Check your connection and refresh.
welcome.notConfigured: Google sign-in is not set up yet (FACESCAN_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is empty).
welcome.devHint: Works only on this computer in development mode. Use a different email to act as a different guest.
welcome.devFailed: Dev sign-in failed. Check the email address.

scan.title: Look here, then blink once.
scan.tipLight: Face a light; avoid strong light behind you
scan.tipFace: Remove sunglasses or a mask; keep your face inside the oval
scan.tipBlink: When asked, blink once. It takes about 3 seconds
scan.agree: I agree that FaceScan may use a live scan of my face to find my photos in events. The scan is not stored.
scan.ready: Fit your face in the oval
scan.cameraOff: Your camera turns on only after you agree.
scan.privacy: Frames stay in memory, are compared once and then discarded.
scan.searchingText: This usually takes a few seconds.
scan.errCamera: We could not open your camera. Allow camera access and try again.
scan.errSpoof: That did not look like a live face. Please scan your real face, not a photo or a screen.
scan.errBlink: We did not see a blink. Please blink once when asked.
scan.errDark: It is too dark. Move to better light and try again.
scan.errBlurry: The image was blurry. Hold your phone still and try again.
scan.errBright: Too much light. Move away from the bright light and try again.
scan.errFace: Keep exactly one face in the oval: just yours.
scan.errTooMany: Too many scans for now. Please try again later.
scan.errNotice: The notice has changed. Please refresh the page.
scan.errSignedOut: You were signed out. Please sign in again.
scan.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
scan.stepFindFace: Keep your face in the oval

methodHint.live: Phone watches your eyes and captures the blink
methodHint.burst: Takes 5 quick photos while you blink
methodHint.look: No blink; only the fake-photo check (test only)

scan.usedFallback: Live blink could not start on this phone, so Quick burst was used.

photos.title: Your photos
photos.firstText: Do a quick face scan and we will look for you in every event.
photos.noneText: We did not find you in any event photos right now. If the photographer is still uploading, try again a little later.
photos.notMeFailed: That did not work. Please try again.

studio.title: Your events
studio.eventNamePlaceholder: New event name, e.g. Riya and Aman wedding
studio.dropText: or tap to choose. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 25 MB each.
studio.uploaded: {{count}} photos uploaded. They will be searchable in a few minutes.
studio.uploadFailed: Some photos could not be uploaded. Try those again.
studio.tooLarge: A photo is larger than the upload limit.
studio.noImages: Choose image files (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC).
studio.createFailed: The event could not be created.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: Choose which events may look for your face. Turning an event off hides its photos from you and keeps it out of new scans. Nothing is deleted, so you can turn it back on.
privacyPage.none: No events yet. After your first scan, every event you were searched in appears here.
privacyPage.confirmOff: Turn off face search for this event? Its photos are hidden and new scans skip it. You can turn it back on later.
privacyPage.doneOff: Turned off. This event's photos are hidden and new scans will skip it.
privacyPage.doneOn: Turned back on. Your photos from this event are visible again.
privacyPage.everywhereText: Lost a phone or used a shared computer? Sign out everywhere at once.

findMore.title: Find more of your photos
findMore.intro: Some photos miss your face (from the side, far away, in a crowd). Describe the moment, tap your face in the blurred previews, and confirm with a quick live scan.
findMore.noEvents: Do a face scan first so we know which events you were at.
findMore.queryHint: e.g. dancing on stage, cutting the cake
findMore.nothing: No photos matched that description. Try other words.
findMore.tapYourFace: Faces are blurred for everyone's privacy. Tap the box over your face.
findMore.confirmText: A quick live scan checks that this face is yours. Nothing is stored.
findMore.released: It matched. The photo is now in your photos.
findMore.queued: We could not confirm it automatically, so the organiser will check your request.
findMore.claimFailed: The claim could not be sent. Please try again.

eventLink.invalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask the organiser for a new one.
eventLink.intro: Find every photo of you from this event with one quick face scan.
eventLink.signInFirst: Sign in first. You will come straight back here.
eventLink.scanNow: Scan your face to find your photos from this event.
eventLink.foundAlready: We already found photos of you here.
